title: Pre-holiday and monthly expiry week on index futures
hypothesis: Index futures held for one or two sessions before an NSE trading holiday, or through the monthly expiry week, earn a higher mean daily return than other sessions and a positive return after charges.

mechanism.text: Pre-holiday optimism and short covering; expiry-week hedging, rolls and pinning.

evidence.finding: High returns on sessions before holidays.

universe.name: nifty-banknifty-futures
universe.rule: Near-month futures; NSE trading holidays from the dated calendar; the monthly expiry week only.

turnover.basis: about 12-15 events a year a variant x 0.080% futures round trip

prior_trials.basis: No calendar rule has been run in this repo.

holdout_rule.pass_if: Holdout net return after charges above zero and the in-window mean above other sessions'.

kill_criteria: Holdout net at or below zero after charges.
In-window mean not above other sessions' (bootstrap p above 0.10).
Expiry-week variant: a sign flip between the Thursday-expiry and Tuesday-expiry eras.

prior.reason: Few events a year, scattered Indian evidence, expiry rules changed several times.

feasibility.reason: Needs dated historical holidays and expiries (#71); otherwise simple.

contamination: trader-regime and the lab's regime split read NIFTY 50 closes for 2024 to 2026; no calendar or trend rule on index futures has been run in this repo. The holdout overlaps those sessions.
